items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: 20 promise tests via the driver, promise_list.json with six statuses, scenarios.json (8), hashing helper with tests, trace-only parts own entries, AC11 recorded as gap

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: hasher raises ValueError for a missing test or a missing/malformed covers id; meta tests name the offending entry

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: test support only; no network, no secrets, no product change

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: oracle judges every promise; hash tests prove what is ignored and what must move; meta tests have red cases by construction

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: golden root about 7 min on Windows, promise tests about 90 s

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: all files <= 300 lines, ruff clean, meta file named so the promise glob misses it

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: promise_list.json and scenarios.json are read back by a test; the fingerprint is computed from source text only so it is OS independent; AC11 half and trace parts probed
